colour_coordinates: moves named in the colours of the colouring they act on; no renaming between moves

witness_semantics.target_macro: in the table; weight-independent; reaches p = 0
witness_semantics.decreasing_endpoint: per hard state in table order, an index into that state's complete endpoint list whose endpoint rank is lower under w
witness_semantics.stuck_state: a hard state index; no endpoint in its complete list is lower under w
